source: Limited sanitized #132 summary; surrounding config is explicitly diagnostic.

input.description: Limited #132 summary: known original speed RPE and lower completions; complete saved programme/current recovery/running unavailable.
expectations: Preserve original RPE2; append approximate5 review separately, never use it as a maximum/velocity measurement.
A familiar speed reference may improve explanation/calibration; no required numeric target or automatic increase.
No recent heavy bench/current recovery/running data exist: do not fabricate them or declare full recovery.
Light/maintenance/recovery meanings must remain distinguishable; a single lower completion is not whole-programme clearance.
limitations: Only attributedBefore and the dates/exercise/count/load/reps/RPE in data.sets/performanceReviews represent the supplied sanitized summary; row expansion/set indices/straight roles/targets are diagnostic representation, not exported native records.

Owner rows have no fabricated clock time, venue, variant/load identity, execution or session/programme identifier. Config equipment inventory is a synthetic feasibility assumption, not a claim about the owner venue.
Baseline154.45 is the reported old speed-wave basis, not a new measured maximum.
Unknown training age, diagnostic week boundaries/availability/role order and zero requested runs are modeling choices; they do not reconstruct the active programme.
No full saved snapshot, current symptoms, next-day tolerance, recent heavy bench, running performance or running volume supplied.

config.strengthModePolicy: Single-lift competition defaults other lifts to maintenance; explicit per-lift objectives override this default.

runningDoseEvidence.coverage: Partial logs are observations only; completeness and habitual capacity are not inferred.
runningDoseEvidence.progressionUse: Future increases are conditional proposals. Confirm completed dose, adherence and recovery at review; a week number is not evidence of adaptation.

coachingInstructions.missedSession: Skip or move one session only if the next key session and recovery still fit. Do not stack missed quality, heavy work or long runs. After two missed sessions, illness or a week away, review the next block.
coachingInstructions.liftingEffort: Warm up to the prescribed effort. RPE governs the suggested kg. If effort overshoots by a point, reduce 2.5–5% and reassess; if still excessive, omit remaining back-offs. Heavy singles are skill practice, not forced maximal attempts.
coachingInstructions.speedWork: Accelerate with stable technique. Reduce load or stop when speed or position deteriorates. An easy speed day is not permission to turn it into a heavy day.
coachingInstructions.athleteJudgement: Report sustained fatigue, sleep disruption, pain, illness or altered movement. End the provoking work when needed. One difficult session is a reason to adjust that session, not an automatic full deload.
coachingInstructions.review: Review completed work every four weeks and after events. Later blocks are conditional on observed recovery and performance; no race result or lifting total is guaranteed.

coachingInstructions.missedSession: Skip or move one session only if the next key session and recovery still fit. Do not stack missed quality, heavy work or long runs. After two missed sessions, illness or a week away, review the next block.
coachingInstructions.liftingEffort: Warm up to the prescribed effort. RPE governs the suggested kg. If effort overshoots by a point, reduce 2.5–5% and reassess; if still excessive, omit remaining back-offs. Heavy singles are skill practice, not forced maximal attempts.
coachingInstructions.speedWork: Accelerate with stable technique. Reduce load or stop when speed or position deteriorates. An easy speed day is not permission to turn it into a heavy day.
coachingInstructions.athleteJudgement: Report sustained fatigue, sleep disruption, pain, illness or altered movement. End the provoking work when needed. One difficult session is a reason to adjust that session, not an automatic full deload.
coachingInstructions.review: Review completed work every four weeks and after events. Later blocks are conditional on observed recovery and performance; no race result or lifting total is guaranteed.
